{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "Silk slip dress, fluid bias-cut silhouette falling to mid-calf length, #e6c0b0 soft rose champagne, lightweight woven silk.
Ankle booties, sleek pointed toe with a moderate stiletto heel, #2a2424 espresso black, smooth calfskin leather.
Gold drop earrings and a delicate pearl pendant necklace.

This outfit works because the fluid silk slip dress offers an elegant evening silhouette perfect for a friend's birthday celebration without feeling overly formal. The deep espresso ankle boots ground the soft rose champagne color of the dress while adding sophistication appropriate for a Saturday night out in autumn. Together, these pieces create a balanced look that transitions seamlessly from dinner to dancing while respecting her preference for everyday style levels."}
